Q01.sql:
WITH closures AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_account_closure_call, conversation_id, NULL)) AS closure_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls`
  GROUP BY site_id
),
cost_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(total_expense) AS total_expense_2025
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly`
  WHERE month_start BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  COALESCE(c.closure_calls, 0) AS closure_calls,
  COALESCE(k.total_expense_2025, 0) AS total_expense_2025
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
LEFT JOIN closures AS c ON s.site_id = c.site_id
LEFT JOIN cost_2025 AS k ON s.site_id = k.site_id
ORDER BY closure_calls DESC

Q02.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(score_date) AS score_date FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3`), high_balance AS (SELECT customer_key, AVG(avg_balance_30d) AS avg_balance FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_features.feat_customer_daily` WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_features.feat_customer_daily`) GROUP BY customer_key HAVING AVG(avg_balance_30d) >= 100000) SELECT s.risk_band AS churn_risk_band, c.segment AS segment, CASE WHEN c.tenure_months < 12 THEN '0-1y' WHEN c.tenure_months < 60 THEN '1-5y' ELSE '5y+' END AS tenure_band, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS customers, AVG(s.churn_probability) AS avg_churn_probability FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3` s JOIN latest l ON s.score_date = l.score_date JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_customer` c ON c.customer_key = s.customer_key JOIN high_balance h ON h.customer_key = s.customer_key GROUP BY churn_risk_band, segment, tenure_band ORDER BY churn_risk_band, segment, tenure_band

Q05.sql:
WITH eom AS (
 SELECT
 account_key,
 product_code,
 DATE_TRUNC(balance_date, MONTH) AS month_start,
 ARRAY_AGG(ledger_balance ORDER BY balance_date DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS eom_balance
 FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_daily_account_balances`
 GROUP BY account_key, product_code, month_start
)
SELECT
 eom.month_start,
 p.product_line,
 SUM(eom.eom_balance) AS month_end_balance
FROM eom
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_product` p
 ON eom.product_code = p.product_code
GROUP BY eom.month_start, p.product_line
ORDER BY eom.month_start, p.product_line

L37d38fdd.sql:
WITH purchase_interchange AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(t.post_date, MONTH) AS post_month,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    t.interchange AS interchange
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_card_transactions` AS t
  LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_customer` AS c
    ON t.customer_key = c.customer_key
  WHERE t.is_purchase
    AND t.post_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  post_month,
  customer_segment,
  COALESCE(SUM(interchange), 0) AS total_interchange
FROM purchase_interchange
GROUP BY post_month, customer_segment
ORDER BY post_month, customer_segment

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    fct_calls.site_id AS site_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(fct_calls.conversation_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    COUNTIF(fct_calls.is_abandoned) AS abandoned_calls,
    COUNT(*) AS total_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS fct_calls
  WHERE fct_calls.conversation_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  dim_cc_site.site_name AS site_name,
  weekly.week_start AS week_start,
  weekly.abandoned_calls AS abandoned_calls,
  weekly.total_calls AS total_calls,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(weekly.abandoned_calls, weekly.total_calls) AS abandon_rate
FROM weekly
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS dim_cc_site
  ON weekly.site_id = dim_cc_site.site_id
ORDER BY abandon_rate DESC
LIMIT 500

WITH open_loans AS (
  SELECT
    account_key,
    product_code,
    branch_id
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE account_family = 'LOAN'
    AND is_open
),
snap AS (
  SELECT
    account_key,
    dpd
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily`
  WHERE snapshot_date = '2026-04-05'
)
SELECT
  a.product_code AS product_code,
  p.product_name AS product_name,
  a.branch_id AS branch_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_key) AS open_loans,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(s.dpd >= 30, a.account_key, NULL)) AS delinquent_loans_30_plus,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(s.dpd >= 30, a.account_key, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_key)) AS delinquency_rate
FROM open_loans a
LEFT JOIN snap s
  ON s.account_key = a.account_key
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_product` p
  ON p.product_code = a.product_code
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY delinquency_rate DESC

WITH engagement AS (
  SELECT
    e.campaign_id,
    COUNTIF(e.delivered) AS delivered,
    COUNTIF(e.opened) AS opened,
    COUNTIF(e.clicked) AS clicked
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_marketing.fct_campaign_engagement` e
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2026-04-12'
  GROUP BY e.campaign_id
)
SELECT
  c.campaign_id,
  c.campaign_name,
  en.delivered,
  en.opened,
  en.clicked,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(en.clicked, en.delivered) AS click_through_rate
FROM engagement en
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_marketing.dim_campaign` c
  ON c.campaign_id = en.campaign_id
WHERE NOT c.is_archived
ORDER BY en.delivered DESC
